sections.intent: Detail the data collection and ingestion capabilities that form the foundation of the platform.
sections.headline: Capture what matters. Discard what doesn't.
sections.subheadline: Nullpoint's ingestion layer strips PII at the edge before data ever reaches our servers.

items.title: Edge-Side PII Stripping
items.description: Our collection script inspects payloads at the network edge and removes any field matching known PII patterns — emails, IPs, device IDs — before transmission.

items.title: Schema-Enforced Events
items.description: Define your event taxonomy once. Nullpoint rejects malformed or unexpected fields at ingest, keeping your data clean and your schema honest.

items.title: Server-Side & Client-Side SDKs
items.description: Track from the browser, mobile app, or your backend. All SDKs share the same typed event model and produce identical output.

items.title: Retroactive Event Replay
items.description: Updated your schema? Replay historical events through the new model without re-instrumenting your product.

sections.intent: Directly compare Nullpoint against traditional analytics platforms to help evaluators articulate the difference to internal stakeholders.
sections.headline: Legacy analytics was built before privacy mattered. We started after.
sections.body: Most analytics platforms were architected in an era of unlimited data collection. Privacy features were bolted on later as regulatory pressure mounted. Nullpoint was designed from the ground up with the assumption that personal data should never be collected in the first place.

items.title: Cookieless Tracking
items.description: Nullpoint: Native. No consent banner needed. Legacy platforms: Requires cookie consent, degrades with refusal.

items.title: GDPR Compliance

items.title: Data Ownership

items.title: Script Weight
items.description: Nullpoint: Under 1 KB gzipped. Legacy platforms: Typically 17–45 KB, impacting Core Web Vitals.

pages.meta_description: Nullpoint's security architecture: SOC 2 Type II certified, end-to-end encryption, zero PII storage, pen-tested annually, and compliant with GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA.

sections.intent: Document the core infrastructure security controls that protect data at every layer.
sections.headline: Defense in depth, from the edge to the archive.

items.title: TLS 1.3 Everywhere
items.description: All data in transit is encrypted with TLS 1.3. We enforce HSTS and reject connections from clients that cannot support modern cipher suites.

items.title: AES-256 At Rest
items.description: All stored data is encrypted with AES-256. Encryption keys are managed by a dedicated KMS with automatic 90-day rotation.

items.title: Zero-Trust Network Architecture
items.description: Internal services communicate over mTLS. No service has implicit trust. Every request is authenticated and authorized independently.

items.title: Immutable Audit Logs
items.description: All system and user actions are written to an append-only, cryptographically signed audit log. Logs cannot be modified or deleted by any user, including admins.

items.title: Annual Penetration Testing
items.description: We contract an independent third-party firm for full-scope penetration testing every year. Executive summaries are available to enterprise customers under NDA.

items.title: Vulnerability Disclosure Program
items.description: Our responsible disclosure program is open to all researchers. Critical findings are triaged within 24 hours and patched within 72 hours.

sections.intent: List all certifications, compliance frameworks, and regulatory standards that Nullpoint has achieved or maintains.
sections.headline: Audited, certified, and verifiable.
sections.subheadline: We don't self-certify. Every claim on this page is backed by a third-party audit or a legal opinion.

items.title: SOC 2 Type II
items.description: Annual audit covering Security, Availability, and Confidentiality trust service criteria. Report available to enterprise customers under NDA.

items.title: GDPR
items.description: Nullpoint operates as a Data Processor under GDPR Article 28. Our DPA is pre-signed and available for immediate download. No negotiations required for standard terms.

items.title: CCPA
items.description: We qualify as a Service Provider under CCPA. We do not sell or share personal information. Our CCPA addendum is included in all customer agreements.

items.title: HIPAA
items.description: Enterprise customers in healthcare can execute a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). Our infrastructure meets HIPAA Technical Safeguard requirements.

items.title: ISO 27001
items.description: Nullpoint is currently pursuing ISO 27001 certification. Gap analysis is complete and Stage 1 audit is scheduled for Q3.

items.title: Privacy Shield Successor (DPF)
items.description: Nullpoint is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, enabling lawful transatlantic data transfers without Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.intent: Explain the privacy architecture philosophy in plain language — written for legal and executive readers who want to understand the principle, not just the controls.
sections.headline: We built Nullpoint on a simple premise: the best way to protect user data is to never collect it.
sections.body: Most analytics companies approach privacy as a compliance problem — a set of rules to satisfy while collecting as much data as possible. We approached it as a design constraint. If a feature requires personal data, we ask whether there is a privacy-preserving alternative that delivers equivalent insight. In most cases, there is. Differential privacy, k-anonymity thresholds, and aggregate-only APIs are not afterthoughts at Nullpoint — they are the foundation. The result is a platform where your users' privacy is protected not by policy, but by architecture. You cannot leak what you never collected.

sections.intent: Pre-empt the most common questions that arise at the contact stage to reduce friction and increase form submission confidence.
sections.headline: Before you hit send.

items.title: Do I need a credit card to start a trial?
items.description: No. The 14-day trial is fully featured and requires only a work email address. You will not be charged unless you explicitly upgrade.

items.title: How long does an enterprise evaluation take?
items.description: Most enterprise evaluations run 3–4 weeks from first demo to signed contract. We provide a dedicated sandbox environment and a security package on day one.

items.title: Can I get your SOC 2 report before signing anything?
items.description: Yes. We provide our SOC 2 Type II executive summary under a standard mutual NDA. Full report access is included in the enterprise evaluation package.

items.title: Do you offer volume discounts for high-event-volume customers?
items.description: Yes. Enterprise pricing is based on monthly event volume with tiered discounts. Our solutions engineers will model pricing against your current or projected usage.

items.title: What happens to my data if I cancel?
items.description: You have 30 days after cancellation to export all your data via our API or dashboard. After 30 days, all data is permanently and verifiably deleted. You receive a deletion certificate.
